studio.welcome.title: Create your first album in minutes
studio.welcome.subtitle: Upload your files, organize them, then save the album to unlock Studio Pro (generation & export).
studio.welcome.upload.title: 1) Upload files
studio.welcome.upload.hint: Upload up to 20 files (photos/videos). We handle the rest.
studio.welcome.upload.dropSubtitle: Photos & videos — drag & drop or click
studio.welcome.steps.organize.title: 2) Organize
studio.welcome.steps.organize.body: Reorder items, rename them, and fix dates if needed.
studio.welcome.steps.generate.title: 3) Generate
studio.welcome.steps.save.title: 4) Save
studio.welcome.steps.save.body: Saving switches this album to Studio Pro for this project.
studio.welcome.steps.share.title: 5) Export & share
studio.welcome.steps.share.body: Export a final video and share it via a private link.

studio.tour.welcome.import.title: Import your memories
studio.tour.welcome.import.body: Add photos/videos in one click. They’ll be automatically added to your first album.
studio.tour.welcome.import.tip: You can also drag & drop in the center area.
studio.tour.welcome.progress.title: Track progress
studio.tour.welcome.progress.body: We prepare, upload to S3, then register your files and attach them to the album.
studio.tour.welcome.progress.tip: If a step fails, simply retry the upload.
studio.tour.welcome.continue.title: Move to organization
studio.tour.welcome.continue.body: Once upload is done, click here to reorder and edit your files.
studio.tour.welcome.continue.tip: Reordering happens without a page reload.
studio.tour.welcome.save.title: Save to unlock Studio Pro
studio.tour.welcome.save.body: Saving enables Studio Pro for this album (generation & export).
studio.tour.welcome.save.tip: You can purchase credits later if needed.
studio.tour.organize.reorder.title: Reorder your memories
studio.tour.organize.reorder.body: Use ↑/↓ (or drag & drop if enabled) to get the right rhythm in your album.
studio.tour.organize.edit.title: Edit title & date
studio.tour.organize.edit.body: Rename an item and adjust its date for a clean timeline.
studio.tour.organize.edit.tip: Accurate dates help exports and rendering.
studio.tour.organize.saveOrder.title: Save the order
studio.tour.organize.saveOrder.body: Stores the order in the database to keep everything smooth and stable.
